title: draw.io: free Lucidchart alternative
caption:
Lucidchart charges $9/month to draw flowcharts. draw.io does it for free 📊

✅ Drag-and-drop shapes: flowcharts, BPMN, AWS and more
✅ Works as a desktop app, no sign-up needed
✅ Your diagrams stay in files on your computer
✅ No analytics, and no diagram data is sent anywhere

💻 Mac · Windows · Linux
ℹ️ Lucidchart's $9/month is its Individual plan billed annually (about $108 a year), and it also has a limited free plan. draw.io is free in the browser too

Comment "CHART" and I'll DM you the link 🔗
